what: On origin/main 136432aa02 two tests of the feature were red: syntax's union_types_parse_only_under_the_extension and hir-ty's question_mark_widens_a_member_or_a_subset. `Result<(), A | B>` was a syntax error ("expected R_ANGLE"): generic_arg parses a name-first argument itself and never went on to the union's `|`. The form the feature exists for did not parse, three days after it landed.
cost: 30 minutes to find; the feature was unusable in a Result since 2026-11-09
cause: the tests were written with the feature and not run on the merged tree
whys: the change was merged with its own tests red
merges are admin merges without CI for some lanes
no gate runs the front-end crates' cargo tests on main
class: a test that is red on main and nobody is told
prevention: the green head of rule fan-out-write-only covers check-compiling only; a nightly run of cargo test -p for the front-end crates with a baseline of known failures that may only shrink; not built
